render_protocol_resolution.selected_pickcube_status: renderer=none; no selected PickCube window or synchronized task-camera route is established
render_protocol_resolution.reset_capture_phase_gap: Current consumer config labels reset-initial capture post_control_step; future 5c must add call-time reset_initial identity. Not implementation evidence.
render_protocol_resolution.shared_scene_policy: Provider/session retains native scene/model/App ownership; renderer borrows a typed generation-bound limited lease and consumes only completed public state.
render_protocol_resolution.independent_renderer_policy: Renderer-owned visual model/data may perform required kinematics but no second physics advance and no mutation of live physics state.
render_protocol_resolution.rgb_policy: Canonical output must specify dimensions/layout/channel/color/range/dtype/device/completion/lifetime; owned storage by default, borrowed lease/fence explicit; zero/shape-only is not success.
render_protocol_resolution.batch_image_layout: env -> worker -> local row -> camera -> image; same-step terminal frame before mask reset, reset frame after reset; preserve terminal_observation/reset_info; never broadcast one worker frame as distinct row observations.
render_protocol_resolution.close_policy: Renderer stops capture/presentation and releases own resources/leases; original provider/App/worker owner closes shared resources after final lease.

historical_planning_fields.meaning: Frozen planning snapshot from 2026-11-03; NOT_RUN cells are final G07 goals, not statements that no earlier bounded evidence exists. Do not rewrite historical results.

current_support.accepted_scope: G01–G05 and E00–E16 retain maintainer bounded acceptance, with the original evidence identities and approved exceptions. U3 and later Isaac solution-002 use the accepted same-run joint completion evidence; they are not pending a new U3 decision. Subsequent C1–C5 implementation at 7f8796b4 has bounded review and impact verification recorded in ../maintenance/reviews/20261114_post_optimization_c5_final.md and ../maintenance/reviews/20261114_g05_pre_g06_readiness_7f8796b4.md; this does not expand supported intersections or Qualification.
current_support.renderer_scope: Fixed for Env lifetime; historical borrowed native and GeoPhys physics × MuJoCo renderer evidence remains source-scoped. Isaac 6.2 PhysX CUDA × Isaac RTX also supports a qualified frame-mounted task camera in the measured PickCube seed31 controlled-lift diagnostic (430 transitions, 431 RGB observations); MuJoCo/GeoPhys moving task cameras remain unsupported. This diagnostic is not the state-only full Solution run or a general renderer qualification. Post-optimization C4 separately exercised reset, one nonzero step, two same-boundary captures, second reset and close on that Isaac wrist RGB route; its seven listed frozen source hashes match 7f8796b4, and the closed H5 was independently reread. See ../maintenance/reviews/20261114_post_optimization_c4_task_rgb.md. C5 full Solutions remain state-only; other native/cross/window evidence is reused at its original source identity, not claimed as a final-HEAD rerun.
current_support.batch_scope: G06a attempt001 implements an explicit MJWarp 4.0.1 CUDA device batch for Pendulum, with B=3 native and same-step lifecycle evidence; it is PARTIAL and awaits independent review. Other formal tasks remain unsupported on this route. Recorder integration and CUDA uint8 Rasterizer output are absent; G06 is not accepted. See ../api/README.md.
current_support.g07_scope: Three providers × three seeds remains an unrun final gate; these single-seed records do not fill final_pickcube_cells.
current_support.record_completion_scope: Five routes use same-run joint evidence: independent H5 readback and caller completion with verified identities. Four canonical H5 files lack completion field; Isaac v3 field is null. No H5-only completion claim; independent review supports bounded maintainer-authorized acceptance.
